study_info.title: Annual High-Dose Oral Vitamin D and Falls and Fractures in Older Women: A Randomized Controlled Trial
study_info.authors: Kerrie M. Sanders, PhD; Amanda L. Stuart, BappSc; Elizabeth J. Williamson, MA, PhD; Julie A. Simpson, PhD; Mark A. Kotowicz, MBBS, FRACP; Doris Young, MD, MBBS, FRACGP; Geoffrey C. Nicholson, PhD, FRACP
study_info.study_design: Single-center, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial. Randomization was performed by an independent statistician using computer-generated randomization of numbers performed in blocks of 500.
study_info.inclusion_criteria: Women 70 years or older, community-dwelling, residing in southern Victoria, Australia, at higher risk of hip fracture (defined by criteria such as maternal hip fracture, past fracture, or self-reported faller).
study_info.exclusion_criteria: Could not provide informed consent or information about falls or fractures; permanently resided at a high-level care facility; had an albumin-corrected calcium level higher than 2.65 mmol/L; had a creatinine level higher than 150 µmol/L; or currently took vitamin D doses of 400 IU or more, calcitriol, or antifracture therapy.
study_info.study_setting: Single center, community-based, southern Victoria, Australia.
study_info.source_of_recruitment: Invitation letters were sent to all age-eligible women listed on the electoral roll of the region surrounding the study center.
study_info.dropout_reasons: Vitamin D group: 110 withdrawals (47 died, 23 became ill, 17 lacked interest, 8 thought they were too old or developed dementia, 6 left for personal reasons, 9 other); Placebo group: 116 withdrawals (40 died, 29 became ill, 14 lacked interest, 13 thought they were too old or developed dementia, 8 left for personal reasons, 12 other).

minimal_units.timepoint: annual dosing, followed for 3 to 5 years
minimal_units.intervention_details: 500 000 IU of cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) administered orally as 10 tablets taken on a single day each year (March-August), for 3 to 5 years.
minimal_units.adherence_to_intervention: Ingestion of study medication was confirmed annually for all other participants. At the end of the study, approximately 3% (38 of 1131) in the vitamin D group were taking more than 400 IU/d of vitamin D supplements.

outcomes.outcome_unit: number of participants with at least one event
outcomes.domain_match: Matches 'major adverse cardiovascular events' as cardiovascular events are reported.
outcomes.comparison_targets: Vitamin D group vs Placebo group

outcomes.domain_match: Matches 'all-cause mortality' as number of deaths is reported.
outcomes.comparison_targets: Vitamin D group vs Placebo group

minimal_units.timepoint: annual dosing, followed for 3 to 5 years
minimal_units.control_details: Identical placebo tablets, taken as 10 tablets on a single day each year (March-August), for 3 to 5 years.
minimal_units.adherence_to_control: Ingestion of study medication was confirmed annually for all other participants. At the end of the study, approximately 6% (65 of 1125) in the placebo group were taking more than 400 IU/d of vitamin D supplements.
